subject: Missed calls after hours
body: Hi, we're a 3-location dental group and we miss a lot of calls after 5pm and on weekends. We'd like an AI receptionist that answers, books appointments into our calendar and texts a confirmation. Budget is around $7,500 and we'd love to launch in 4 weeks. Can you help?

subject: Automate delivery exception emails
body: We receive about 300 delivery exception emails a day. Someone reads each one and forwards it to the right team. Can AI classify and route these automatically and log them in our TMS? We have a budget of $6,000 and need it in 3 weeks.

subject: Assistant for our patient guides
body: Our care team answers the same questions about prep instructions and billing. We want a chatbot on the patient portal that answers from our patient guides and FAQ. Budget $10,000, timeline 6 weeks.

subject: Rank #1 on Google
body: We can rank your agency website on page one of Google in 30 days with our premium backlinks package. Reply to get started!

subject: Claude + our listings database
body: We're a real estate brokerage. Our agents want to ask Claude questions about our listings and CRM data instead of building reports. Is that possible with MCP? We can spend about $9,000 over 5 weeks.

subject: Product questions chatbot
body: Small bike shop with an online store. Looking for a chatbot to answer sizing and delivery questions. Budget is limited, maybe $800.

subject: Help desk assistant for agents
body: Our insurance agents keep asking the same coverage questions. We'd like an internal assistant that answers from our policy documents. We have about $2,500 to start and want something in 5 weeks.
